contentList.content: If you worship Talos, your first attack each turn with this bow creates an electrified storm with a [1] radius.

In the darkest corners of storm-ravaged temples, legends speak of a weapon forged during the Great Tempest - when Talos himself walked the land. A zealous priest channeled the Stormlord's fury into this bow, its arrows crackling with divine lightning. Only in the hands of the Destroyer's faithful does its full fury awaken.
